content.comment_body: Is it possible to implement an On-Delay timer where the delay duration can be adjusted through user inputs? For instance, if the input is activated 4 times, it results in a 4-hour delay, 5 activations result in a 5-hour delay, and so on. I've looked for a solution but haven't found a clear answer. Thank you, [user_name]
Hello [user_name], Here's an example you can customize to fit your needs. Hope this is useful.

analysis.insight_summary: A user wants to set a variable On-Delay period based on the count of input activations and has not found an obvious method to do so in the [product_name]. Another user responds with an example for adjustment, suggesting that the required flexibility is possible, even though the effectiveness of the solution is not discussed. The primary challenge is making interactive timing configuration straightforward for users.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for a simple way to configure a time delay directly from the user interface, where the delay duration depends on how many times the input is activated.
